title: The Product Import Export for WooCommerce – CSV Product Importer & Exporter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The Product Import Export for WooCommerce – CSV Product Importer & Exporter plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in all versions up to and including 2.6.9. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of the 'author' field during CSV import. Exploitation requires an attacker to submit a crafted review, which must then be approved by an administrator and re-imported via the plugin's default column mapping. The vulnerability cannot be triggered without administrative actions and specific database table prefix conditions.
